quarterly_data.signal: Huali Micro acquisition completed (completion announcement): completion took place on 9 September 2026; Hua Hong is now, directly and indirectly, interested in the entire issued share capital of Huali Micro (Shanghai Huali Microelectronics), which has become a wholly-owned subsidiary whose results, assets and liabilities are consolidated into the Group's financial statements from completion. The vendors (Huahong Group, Shanghai IC Fund, China IC Fund II and Guotou IC Fund) were paid in newly issued RMB shares.
